system: You are the Orbit IT helpdesk copilot. Help employees fix device, network and account problems using the knowledge-base articles provided in <kb> tags and device telemetry in <telemetry> tags. Prefer the most specific fix first, cite KB ids, and say when a step needs IT to act. Be concise: numbered steps, no more than 6.

turns.content: Hi, it's Dana from Finance. My laptop is asset tag ORB-55812, a ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 11.
Hi Dana, thanks. I have ORB-55812 on file as a ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 11 assigned to Finance. What can I help with today?
First, Outlook stopped showing my team's shared calendar this morning.
Shared calendars can take up to two hours to appear after a permission change. If it is still missing, switch New Outlook off and on, then run File > Account Settings > Repair (KB-106).
The repair worked, the calendar is back. Thanks!
Great. Anything else?
Yes, the bigger problem. My VPN keeps disconnecting. I opened ticket INC-48213 yesterday but nobody has called me.
Sorry about the wait on INC-48213. Let's work through it. Which VPN client and Windows version are you on?
It's GlobalProtect 6.2.1. Windows says version 24H2, I think the update came last week.
Thanks: Windows 11 24H2 with GlobalProtect 6.2.1. How often does it drop, and on which networks?
Roughly every ten minutes. It happens on my home Wi-Fi and it happened at the hotel in Lyon last week too.
Understood. Does it also drop when the laptop is plugged in and actively in use, or mainly when idle on battery?
Even in the middle of Teams calls while plugged in. Calls freeze and then reconnect.
That points away from power saving. Have you tried anything yet?
I already tried reinstalling GlobalProtect from Company Portal, same version. No change.
Noted, a same-version reinstall would not fix a version-specific bug. Let me pull your device telemetry.
Sure. Also, my manager asked if this affects the expense tool, it seemed slow.
The expense tool runs through the VPN, so drops will make it feel slow. It should recover once the VPN is stable.
Makes sense. By the way, the printer on floor 4 jammed again, but facilities fixed it.
Good to hear facilities sorted it. Back to the VPN, I have the telemetry now.
Important: I fly to Singapore next Monday for the quarter-end close, so I really need this fixed before then.
Understood, we will aim to have it fixed well before Monday.
